description: This circular walk explores the Millbrook Warren Woodland area near the Bedfordshire village of Millbrook. The woods are located on the western side of the popular Ampthill Park Estate. They contain miles of peaceful pine woodland trails with lots of birds to look out for. Just west of the village you can climb to Heydon Hill and enjoy some splendid views over the surrounding countryside. The route takes you right around the edge of the Woburn Centre Parcs so it's a good one for anyone staying at the park. The Marston Vale Timberland Trail also passes through the woods so you could pick up this waymarked trail to continue your walking.
